name: diagram-tools
description: Validated Archify maps and editable Mermaid rendering with research figure composition guidance.

interface.shortDescription: Create diagrams and share accepted Archify maps.
interface.longDescription: Diagram Tools makes Archify the graphical default for validated interactive architecture and workflow maps while preserving Pretty Mermaid for explicit Mermaid, compact static diagrams, and terminal ASCII. Research figure guidance uses existing Mermaid flags and Archify presets. Both lanes retain editable source and guarded local runtimes; installation-specific opt-in enables Cloudflare Pages sharing after Archify visual review.
defaultPrompt: Use $archify to create a validated interactive architecture or workflow map with retained typed JSON source.
Use $pretty-mermaid for explicit Mermaid, compact static diagrams, or terminal ASCII.
Render these Mermaid sources as terminal-friendly ASCII.
